name: red-line-toolkit
description: The field guides from redlinedigital.dev — opinionated Claude Code pipelines for high-rigor refactors, module builds, page work, pre-ship audits, and session bookkeeping.

plugins.name: red-line-toolkit
plugins.description: 13 commands + 11 agents + 1 skill + the LedgerLoop ledger: change-heavy, cleanup-light, module-build/sprint, the page-design/code/implement pipeline, module-audit, mobile-audit, competitive-anchor, cluster-fus, pre-commit-check, start/end-session, the-adjudicator and the fable-seat audit agent. Install fable-seat-guard beside it.

plugins.name: fable-seat-guard
plugins.description: Companion to red-line-toolkit: puts every fable-seat subagent on a model family other than the orchestrator's, checks the model that actually started, and holds the seat to read-only tools.
